description: The document lists three `LocalImage.type` values (`unknown_type`, `instance_local`, `instance_sbs`), but the API also answers `instance_local_snapshot` and `instance_sbs_snapshot`. Observed 2026-10-14: `GET /marketplace/v2/local-images?zone=fr-par-1&image_label=ubuntu_noble` answered 200 with six local images whose `type` was `instance_local`, `instance_local_snapshot`, `instance_sbs` or `instance_sbs_snapshot`. The generated type was a closed union that omitted both.
